body:
Nick,

Of course, what one likes to read is a question of taste (or lack thereof), but
what do you consider "literature"? You stated that you like HG Wells, yet don't
like most science fiction, and don't consider it literature, even though some
people do.

I am just curious, given paragraph 17, "Art forms that appeal to modern leftist
intellectuals tend to focus on sordidness, defeat and despair, or else they
take on an orgiastic tone, throwing off rational calculation and all that was
left was to immerse onself in the sensations of the moment." How do you define
literature, and do you agree with ISAIF about this (if you consider literature
one of the arts)?

Thanks,

-Susan
